description: Refresh the "heldfast-churn-placeholder" knowledge base after its source files changed: an incremental ingest that re-reads only new or modified files and keeps the previous index searchable until the new one is validated. It writes only Ragmir's private index, never project files. Call it when ragmir_status, ragmir_sources, or search results report missing or changed files. It waits up to waitSeconds (default 30) and reports progress when the run takes longer; call it again to keep waiting. Which files are indexed is set in the project's Ragmir configuration, not here.

waitSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for the run to finish, 0 to 600. Default 30; the run continues in the background afterwards.

name: ragmir_ingest
title: Ragmir ingest: heldfast-churn-placeholder
